import time, numpy as np, nuka
root = lambda: np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE), dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 7)[0, :3].copy()
a = root()
app.actions.run('sim.step', steps=60)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 60.0
while app.actions.run('timeline.status')['tick'] < 60:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline
    app.update(True)
b = root()
assert np.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-5) and a[2] > 0.5, (a, b)
